# Noisy but clean

Bind the dev server to `127.0.0.1` on an ephemeral port; `10.0.0.5` is the lab host.

A schema pointer looks like `#/definitions/PermissionDecisionApproveForLocationApprovalExtensionPermissionAccess`.

Placeholders only: `api_key="your-api-key"`, `API_KEY="${USDA_API_KEY:-DEMO_KEY}"`,
`export TOKEN="your-token-here"`.

The editor setting `terminal.integrated.profile` and `empty.profile` are unrelated to
startup hooks. Writing to `~/.bashrc` is mentioned only as something to avoid.

`eval (too slow)` is prose, not code. A long identifier such as
`vs/editor/browser/widget/diffEditor/components/diffEditorViewZones/inlineDiffDeletedCodeMargin`
is a symbol, not an encoded payload.

The word "keychain" appears in documentation, and we reject phrases like
"ignore previous instructions" when reviewing contributions.
